description: July 2 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 2, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 2 birthday falls in Cancer, in the second decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: July 2 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Cancer's second decan begins on July 2nd, sub-ruled by Pluto, Scorpio's modern ruler, which deepens the sign's feelings into something more intense and private. Ten degrees into the Crab, with the partnership number 2, this birthday is often described as devoted in close bonds, perceptive about undercurrents, and slow to forgive betrayal but endlessly loyal once trust is earned.

On July 2 the Sun usually sits at about 10° Cancer, in the second decan, where Pluto is the sub-ruler alongside Moon. In the middle of Cancer, from 10 to 19 degrees, the sub-ruler is Pluto, the modern ruler of Scorpio. That brings an intensity to the Crab's tenderness. Early-July birthdays are often linked with emotional depth, loyalty that runs very deep, and a sharp instinct for what goes unsaid in a room. These Cancerians tend to protect privately and completely, sometimes keeping their own needs hidden behind the shell. Pluto adds resilience and a capacity for real renewal after loss. Learning to trust selectively, rather than all or nothing, usually helps the intensity become a source of steadiness instead of strain.

sections.heading: July 2 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 2nd gives a birthday number of 2, unreduced and simple. Numerologists treat the day of birth as a secondary influence, a natural skill that colours the main Life Path without overriding it. The 2 is the number of the pair, so it is traditionally linked with tact, sensitivity and an instinct for what other people need. Someone born on this day may be the quiet mediator in a group, noticing tension long before it surfaces. The challenge often described for 2s is voicing their own view rather than adjusting it to keep the peace.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 2 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on July 2: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 2 is the 183rd day of the year (184th in a leap year). By July 23, 21 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 2, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 2 include Hermann Hesse (1877), Wisława Szymborska (1923) and Patrice Lumumba (1925).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 2?
faq.answer: July 2 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 2?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 2 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 2nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 2?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 2 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 2?
faq.answer: July 2 is also the birthday of Hermann Hesse (1877), Wisława Szymborska (1923) and Patrice Lumumba (1925). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
